source: Moss et al. (2013) Trusting Intensive Care Unit (ICU) Medical Data
text: Each observation is evaluated by a data quality assessment. Errors are classified as either a Possible Error (PoE), where a reading is outside an acceptable range, or a Probable Error (PrE), where the error is confirmed by clinical context. A PrE may be reclassified as PoE if contextualised by a medical disorder such as sepsis or hypertension, or by a recent treatment such as noradrenaline or adrenaline.
